text:
Ava (PM): FYI — Fjord Health asked for a predictable low-cost inference mode for bursty medical transcription. Proposed name: Predictive Batching. Need cross-team handshake on scope + launch gates. Can we align on must-haves and blockers?

Liam (Eng Runtime): Love the concept. Quick questions: target p95 latency? token throughput expectations? Also need to know if we accept slightly lower quality from aggressive batching/quantization.

Ava (PM): Target p95 <= 150ms for 512-token avg requests, initial traffic: 1K concurrent users peak, goal to support 5k concurrent within 3 months. Business says cost-per-1M-tokens <= $18 target. Quality: no regression on clinical entity extraction tests (will provide eval set).

Sam (Services Eng): For the hosted API flow we'll need a routing policy + canary for model variants. Propose canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with observability hooks. Need infra numbers for baseline replicas.

Rina (Infra): Capacity ask noted. To hit 1k conc we estimate needing 6 dedicated GPUs with baseline batching improvements; for 5k conc ~30 GPUs. Need contract lead time if Dedicated pools required. Also: network egress region constraints for Fjord (EU data residency).

Diego (Security): Two quick items: (1) Fjord requires a completed IRP + PenTest signoff for PHI handling, (2) we need a threat model for predictive batching (does KV cache expose cross-tenant prefixes?). We can do expedited review but needs artifacts.

Ava (PM): I'll drop the eval set, contract notes, and Fjord's compliance checklist into this thread. Proposed timeline: spec ship next Tue, alpha with internal routing + observability in 3 weeks, external pilot in 6 weeks. Are timelines realistic?

Liam (Eng Runtime): 3 weeks for alpha is tight but doable if we scope alpha to: (a) batching policy plugin, (b) one quantized model variant, (c) telemetry for p95/p99, cost per token. We'll need a small api extension for 'batch_hint' so SDK can signal user intensity.

Sam (Services Eng): Agree. I'll add a temporary feature-flag route and a canary config. Example rollout config I propose:
```
rollout: predictive-batching
steps:
  - percent: 5
    models: [predictive-v1, predictive-quant-v1]
  - percent: 25
    metrics: [latency_p95, error_rate, cost_per_token]
  - percent: 100
    monitor_window: 24h
```

Rina (Infra): To support EU residency we need a dedicated regional pool or private deployment in their VPC. Options: hosted EU pool (fast) vs Dedicated private (longer procurement). For alpha we can scope to hosted EU with strict logging retention and no cross-region fallback.

Diego (Security): On KV cache: require explicit tenant namespacing and cache scrub after TTL. Also require a small fuzzing test on prompt cache collisions. I'll assign a security reviewer — ETA 5 business days if docs are complete.

Ava (PM): Action items so far:
- Product: ship spec + eval set (Ava) — due in 2 days
- Runtime: implement batch_hint + predictive batching plugin (Liam) — alpha in 3 weeks
- Services: feature-flag route + rollout config (Sam) — prepare canary config this week
- Infra: capacity plan for EU hosted vs Dedicated (Rina) — decision by EOD Friday
- Security: threat model + cache tests (Diego) — review in 5 business days
- Ops-bot: reserve capacity estimate? (ops-bot)

ops-bot: capacity-reservation: provisional request created for 8 gpus (eu-west) for 3 weeks. Link: https://infra.redwood/reservations/PR-7832 :information_source:

Sam (Services Eng): I'll wire up the rollout dashboard tiles (latency, cost_per_token, entity-extraction-f1). Want an alert if F1 drops > 3 pts from baseline.

Liam (Eng Runtime): One more runtime risk: aggressive batching may amplify downstream error spikes. Propose an automatic backoff: if error_rate > 0.5% or latency_p95 > 220ms for 5m, degrade batching level by one step. I can add that to the plugin.

Diego (Security): Also require an audit event for any automatic batching fallback (who/what triggered). Helps for incident triage and compliance.

Ava (PM): Good. Final gating checklist for pilot launch (agreed):
- latency_p95 <= 150ms on alpha (observed 24h)
- entity-extraction F1 within -3 pts of baseline on eval set
- security review completed + IRP signoff
- EU residency confirmation + capacity reserved
- rollout + automatic backoff implemented

Rina (Infra): If we hit alpha pass, infra will escalate to request Dedicated pool sizing. For now we'll confirm EU-hosted 8 GPU reservation. Keep me posted on actual memory/VRAM per model variant.

Ava (PM): Thanks everyone. Liam/Rina/Sam — can you ack this thread if your teams are good with the plan? I'll consolidate into a spec doc after acks and ping legal for the compliance checklist.

Liam (Eng Runtime): Ack — runtime will take alpha scope.

Sam (Services Eng): Ack from Services. I'll land the canary config PR today.

Rina (Infra): Ack — infra will fund the provisional EU pool and follow up on Dedicated procurement options.

Diego (Security): Ack — security will start review once spec + threat model are posted.

Ava (PM): Great — I'll post docs and the eval set in this thread in ~2h. :rocket:
